title: Universal block relations
description: Two relation FAMILIES over blocks. STRUCTURAL relations are layer-agnostic (derivable from any document with no genre profile — same_unit, continues, caption_of, adjacent, same_section, footnote_of). PROFILE relations require a Layer-2 role on at least one endpoint (solution_of, practice_of, answers, cites, defines, references). All are DETERMINISTICALLY derived from a validated arrangement + block roles — no model call beyond the arrangement itself.
$comment: Canonical relation shapes cover structural links and profile-role relationships. Every profile relation names at least one Layer-2 role endpoint. See docs/architecture/block-ontology.md#relations and docs/architecture/block-ontology.md#governance.

x-relations.meaning: the listed units form ONE logical block (the merge signal).
x-relations.derivation: arranger: >1 id in a block. cooccurrence: n/a.

x-relations.endpoints: block(page N-1 last non-furniture) -> block(page N first, continues_prev_page)
x-relations.meaning: cross-page text continuation of one logical block across a page break.
x-relations.derivation: arranger: continues_prev_page flag on the first block of a page, materialized cross-page by the driver.

x-relations.meaning: a caption block binds to the figure/table it describes.
x-relations.derivation: arranger: a figure_caption/caption block bound to its nearest non-furniture neighbor.

x-relations.endpoints: block(i) -> block(i+1), consecutive non-furniture in reading order
x-relations.meaning: ordered reading sequence over content blocks (furniture excluded — it is page dressing, not reading sequence).

x-relations.endpoints: block <-> block under the same nearest-preceding heading
x-relations.meaning: two blocks co-member the same section (anchored by the nearest preceding heading). Capped to avoid O(n^2): each member paired to its heading + consecutive member pairs.
a footnote binds to the block carrying its reference marker.
x-relations.derivation: deterministic marker-match (footnote kind -> block with the matching reference marker). NOT yet emitted by the arranger contract (proposed).

x-relations.endpoints: block -> the numbered target block it cites (figure|chart|table|heading|math_block)
x-relations.meaning: an in-text cross-reference ("see Figure 3", "Table 1.2 shows", "as in Section 4.1", "Equation (7)") binds the referring block to its referenced target — the edge retrieval uses to learn document connectivity; target_block_idx null when the target is outside the processed span (target_ref preserves the string).
x-relations.derivation: deterministic numbered-reference pattern match resolved against the document's figure/chart/table/section/equation number registry; NOT yet emitted by the arranger contract (proposed).

x-relations.endpoints: block <-> block within the same independent content thread on a multi-story page
x-relations.meaning: groups the blocks of ONE article/story on pages carrying multiple independent content threads (newspapers, magazines, newsletters) — the designed answer to multi-story segmentation, which same_section cannot represent (a story is a content THREAD; sections subdivide WITHIN a thread; same_section stays intra-story). Absent on single-thread documents — absence asserts the page is one thread.
x-relations.derivation: arranger-level story segmentation (headline anchoring + column-flow continuity), composed with continues for cross-page "continued on p. N" jumps; proposed.

x-relations.meaning: a solution block immediately follows the worked_example / exercise_item it solves.
x-relations.derivation: arranger: solution block immediately after an example block (fires where markup distinguishes them).

x-relations.meaning: a guided-practice prompt binds to the worked example it follows (the de-publishered try_it_of).
x-relations.derivation: cooccurrence: fine_type guided_practice -> nearest preceding example (needs per-block fine role from source markup / lexicon).

x-relations.meaning: an answer_item keys to its exercise_item (answer-key linkage); reused for forms field_value -> field_label.
x-relations.derivation: deterministic number/label match between answer-key entry and exercise item. Proposed.

x-relations.meaning: a legal citation points at the authority it cites.
a definition/key-terms block defines a term (feeds the concept graph / KeyTerm extraction).
x-relations.derivation: deterministic term extraction from the definition block. Proposed.

x-relations.meaning: a scholarly/encyclopedic cross-reference (proof references a lemma; see-also references an article).
